name: Frankenstrat
notes: Hand-built by Eddie Van Halen from mixed parts; iconic black and white stripes; considered one of the most famous electric guitars ever built

name: Blackie
notes: Assembled by Clapton from three 1950s Stratocasters purchased in 1970; his primary guitar from 1973 to 1985; sold at auction in 2004 for $959,500

name: Brownie
notes: Used on the original Layla recording; sold at auction in 1999 for $497,500

name: The Beano Les Paul
notes: Used on the John Mayall & the Bluesbreakers album; named for the Beano comic visible in Clapton's hands on the cover
